title: Add an object
summary: Objective-C: Add an object. Add @9 too. Try a small example and check what happens.
introduction: NSMutableArray allows changes such as adding an object. Read the example, then check the result.

blocks.text: On a Mac with Xcode command-line tools, save lesson.m. Run clang -fobjc-arc -framework Foundation lesson.m -o lesson, then ./lesson.

blocks.title: Add an object

blocks.text: addObject adds a third object to the mutable array. count then gives 3.

blocks.title: Watch out
blocks.text: NSArray is read-only; use a mutable collection for changes.
